cloud_model_dev_ping.description: Cloud model ID used by /dev ping check via Firebase AI Logic.

cloud_model_compile.description: Cloud model ID used to compile public standards into numbered rules.

cloud_model_repair_quote.description: Cloud model ID used to repair non-matching rule quotes during compilation.

cloud_model_exam.description: Cloud model ID used to generate Exam Day questions from public rules.

cloud_model_tutor.description: Cloud model ID used by the Exam Day tutor to refine practice-failing rules.

cloud_model_answer.description: Cloud model ID used for consent-gated cloud answers in Ask and Blueprint.

cloud_model_edge_bench.description: Cloud model ID used to draft Connection Test edges from public rules.

ask_min_score.description: Minimum MiniSearch score below which Ask treats a question as LOW_RETRIEVAL.

exam_ready_critical_pass_rate.description: Minimum held-out critical rule pass rate required for Exam Day Ready status (0..1).

exam_ready_out_of_scope_rate.description: Minimum held-out out-of-scope NONE rate required for Exam Day Ready status (0..1).

edge_min_critical_recall.description: Minimum critical violation recall required to unlock Blueprint verdict mode (0..1).

edge_min_overall_accuracy.description: Minimum overall Connection Test accuracy required to unlock Blueprint verdict mode (0..1).
